text_en: You shall make for yourselves no idols and erect no carved images or pillars, and you shall not place figured stones in your land, to worship at them; for I am the Lord your God.
text_cn: 你们不可制造神像，亦不可立雕像或石柱；在你们境内，亦不可安置石像，供人朝拜，因为我上主是你们的天主。

text_en: You shall keep my sabbaths and reverence my sanctuary: I am the Lord .
text_cn: 你们应遵守我的安息日，尊敬我的圣所：我是上主。

text_en: If you follow my statutes and keep my commandments and observe them faithfully,
text_cn: 如果你们履行我的法令，遵守我的命令，一一依照执行

text_en: I will give you your rains in their season, and the land shall yield its produce, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.
text_cn: 我必按时给你们降下雨露，地必供给出产，田野的树木必结出果实。

text_en: Your threshing shall overtake the vintage, and the vintage shall overtake the sowing; you shall eat your bread to the full, and live securely in your land.
text_cn: 你们打禾必打到收葡萄的时期，收葡萄必收到播种的时期；你们必有食粮吃饱，在境内安居乐业。

text_en: And I will grant peace in the land, and you shall lie down, and no one shall make you afraid; I will remove dangerous animals from the land, and no sword shall go through your land.
text_cn: 我必赐国内太平，你们睡下，没有人惊扰；我必使境内的猛兽消灭，刀剑也不侵入你们境内。

text_en: You shall give chase to your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.
text_cn: 你们追击仇敌时，他们必在你们面前丧身刀下。

text_en: Five of you shall give chase to a hundred, and a hundred of you shall give chase to ten thousand; your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.
text_cn: 你们五人要追击一百，你们百人要追击一万；你们的仇敌必在你们面前丧身刀下。

text_en: I will look with favor upon you and make you fruitful and multiply you; and I will maintain my covenant with you.
text_cn: 我必眷顾你们，使你们繁殖增多；我必固守我与你们所立的盟约。

text_en: You shall eat old grain long stored, and you shall have to clear out the old to make way for the new.
text_cn: 你们要吃久藏的陈粮，要清出陈粮，为贮藏新粮。

text_en: I will place my dwelling in your midst, and I shall not abhor you.
text_cn: 我必在你们中间安置我的住所，再不厌恶你们。

text_en: And I will walk among you, and will be your God, and you shall be my people.
text_cn: 我必住在你们中间，做你们的天主，你们做我的百姓。

text_en: I am the Lord your God who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be their slaves no more; I have broken the bars of your yoke and made you walk erect.
text_cn: 我上主是你们的天主，是我领你们出离了埃及地，不再做他们的奴隶；是我打断了你们轭(è)上的横木，令你们昂首前行。

text_en: But if you will not obey me, and do not observe all these commandments,
text_cn: 但是，如果你们不听从我，不执行这一切命令；

text_en: if you spurn my statutes, and abhor my ordinances, so that you will not observe all my commandments, and you break my covenant,
text_cn: 如果你们弃绝我的法令，厌恶我的制度，不遵行我的一切命令，而破坏我的盟约，

text_en: I in turn will do this to you: I will bring terror on you; consumption and fever that waste the eyes and cause life to pine away. You shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.
text_cn: 我必要这样与你们作对，使你们恐怖，患肺痨疟疾，眼目昏花，心灵憔悴；你们的种子，白白播种，因为你们的仇敌要来吃尽。

text_en: I will set my face against you, and you shall be struck down by your enemies; your foes shall rule over you, and you shall flee though no one pursues you.
text_cn: 我要板起脸来与你们作对，你们必为仇敌击溃，那仇恨你们的要压制你们；虽然没有人追赶，你们也要望风而逃。

text_en: And if in spite of this you will not obey me, I will continue to punish you sevenfold for your sins.
text_cn: 如果这样你们还不听从我，为了你们的罪恶，我必要加重七倍惩罚你们，

text_en: I will break your proud glory, and I will make your sky like iron and your earth like copper.
text_cn: 粉碎你们矜夸的力量，使你们的苍天如铁，使你们的土地像铜，

text_en: Your strength shall be spent to no purpose: your land shall not yield its produce, and the trees of the land shall not yield their fruit.
text_cn: 使你们白费气力，地不供给出产，田野的树木也不结果实。

text_en: If you continue hostile to me, and will not obey me, I will continue to plague you sevenfold for your sins.
text_cn: 如果你们还与我作对，不愿听从我，我必按照你们的罪恶，加重七倍打击你们，

text_en: I will let loose wild animals against you, and they shall bereave you of your children and destroy your livestock; they shall make you few in number, and your roads shall be deserted.
text_cn: 使野兽来伤害你们，夺去你们的子女，残害你们的牲畜，减少你们的人口，使你们的街市变为废墟。

text_en: If in spite of these punishments you have not turned back to me, but continue hostile to me,
text_cn: 如果我用这些事还不能惩戒你们，你们仍然与我作对，

text_en: then I too will continue hostile to you: I myself will strike you sevenfold for your sins.
text_cn: 我也要与你们作对，为了你们的罪恶，必要加重七倍打击你们。

text_en: I will bring the sword against you, executing vengeance for the covenant; and if you withdraw within your cities, I will send pestilence among you, and you shall be delivered into enemy hands.
text_cn: 我必令刀剑临于你们，为报复违背盟约的罪；如果你们退入城市，我必使瘟疫来害你们，叫你们落在仇人手内。

text_en: When I break your staff of bread, ten women shall bake your bread in a single oven, and they shall dole out your bread by weight; and though you eat, you shall not be satisfied.
text_cn: 当我给你们断绝了粮源时，十个女人要在一口灶上烤饼，按定量给你们配给食粮；你们虽然吃，却吃不饱。

text_en: But if, despite this, you disobey me, and continue hostile to me,
text_cn: 如果这样，你们还不听从我，仍然与我作对，

text_en: I will continue hostile to you in fury; I in turn will punish you myself sevenfold for your sins.
text_cn: 我必发怒来与你们作对，为了你们的罪恶，我必加重七倍惩罚你们。

text_en: You shall eat the flesh of your sons, and you shall eat the flesh of your daughters.
text_cn: 你们要吃你们儿子的肉，连你们女儿的肉也要吃。

text_en: I will destroy your high places and cut down your incense altars; I will heap your carcasses on the carcasses of your idols. I will abhor you.
text_cn: 我必破坏你们的丘坛，砍倒你们的香台，将你们的尸首堆在你们的偶像的尸首上。我必厌恶你们，

text_en: I will lay your cities waste, will make your sanctuaries desolate, and I will not smell your pleasing odors.
text_cn: 使你们的城市变为旷野，圣所化为废墟，不愿再闻你们祭品的馨香。

text_en: I will devastate the land, so that your enemies who come to settle in it shall be appalled at it.
text_cn: 我必使你们的地化为废墟，甚至你的仇人来居住时，还惊奇不已。

text_en: And you I will scatter among the nations, and I will unsheathe the sword against you; your land shall be a desolation, and your cities a waste.
text_cn: 我必将你们分散在各民族中，我要拔剑追逐你们，使你们的地成为废墟，城市变为旷野。

text_en: Then the land shall enjoy its sabbath years as long as it lies desolate, while you are in the land of your enemies; then the land shall rest, and enjoy its sabbath years.
text_cn: 当那地方变成荒野，而你们侨居在仇人的地方时，这整个的时期，那地才补上了安息的时候；那时地要休息，补享安息年。

text_en: As long as it lies desolate, it shall have the rest it did not have on your sabbaths when you were living on it.
text_cn: 那地方荒凉的整个时期内，才得到安息，补享你们居住时，在你们的安息年内，未享到的安息。

text_en: And as for those of you who survive, I will send faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies; the sound of a driven leaf shall put them to flight, and they shall flee as one flees from the sword, and they shall fall though no one pursues.
text_cn: 至于你们中残存的人，我必使他们在仇人的地方胆战心惊，甚至风吹落叶声也把他们吓跑，逃跑有如逃避刀剑；虽然无人追赶，他们也跌倒在地。

text_en: They shall stumble over one another, as if to escape a sword, though no one pursues; and you shall have no power to stand against your enemies.
text_cn: 虽然无人追赶，他们却一人倒在另一人身上，如面临刀剑。你们决不能抵挡你们的仇人，

text_en: You shall perish among the nations, and the land of your enemies shall devour you.
text_cn: 只有在各民族中消灭；仇人的土地要把你们吞下。

text_en: And those of you who survive shall languish in the land of your enemies because of their iniquities; also they shall languish because of the iniquities of their ancestors.
text_cn: 你们中残存的人，必为了自己的罪恶，在仇人的地方，日渐衰弱，还要为了祖先的罪恶，日渐衰弱。

text_en: But if they confess their iniquity and the iniquity of their ancestors, in that they committed treachery against me and, moreover, that they continued hostile to me—
text_cn: 他们终必承认自己的罪恶，祖先的罪恶，对我不忠与我作对的叛逆之罪。

text_en: so that I, in turn, continued hostile to them and brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised heart is humbled and they make amends for their iniquity,
text_cn: 当我与他们作对，将他们迁送到他们仇人的地方以后，他们未受割损的心，必会谦卑自下，要心甘情愿受罚赎罪，

text_en: then will I remember my covenant with Jacob; I will remember also my covenant with Isaac and also my covenant with Abraham, and I will remember the land.
text_cn: 我也要想起我同雅各伯所结的盟约，想起同依撒格，同亚巴郎所结的盟约，也想起那地方来。

text_en: For the land shall be deserted by them, and enjoy its sabbath years by lying desolate without them, while they shall make amends for their iniquity, because they dared to spurn my ordinances, and they abhorred my statutes.
text_cn: 但那地方应为他们所放弃，好在他们离去，地方荒芜时，才能补享安息年，同时他们也补赎自己的罪恶，这是因为他们弃绝了我的制度，厌恶了我的法令。

text_en: Yet for all that, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not spurn them, or abhor them so as to destroy them utterly and break my covenant with them; for I am the Lord their God;
text_cn: 但是，即使这样，当他们留在仇人的地方时，我仍不弃绝他们，也不厌恶他们，以致消灭他们，废除我与他们结的盟约，因为我上主是他们的天主。

text_en: but I will remember in their favor the covenant with their ancestors whom I brought out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations, to be their God: I am the Lord .
text_cn: 我顾念他们，我还要想起我与他们的祖先所结的盟约；我在各民族的眼前，由埃及地领出他们的祖先来，为做他们的天主：我是上主。”

text_en: These are the statutes and ordinances and laws that the Lord established between himself and the people of Israel on Mount Sinai through Moses.
text_cn: 这是上主在西乃山，于自己和以色列子民间，藉梅瑟所立定的法令、制度和法律。
